blocks.text: MILWAUKEE — Julius Randle scored 28 points and Noah Clowney had 17 as the Brooklyn Nets beat the Milwaukee Bucks 104-97 to snap a five-game losing streak on Wednesday night in NBA Cup play. Egor Demin added 15, Michael Porter Jr. had 12 points and 11 rebounds and Day’Ron Sharpe chipped in with 11 points and 14 rebounds for Brooklyn, which improved to 1-2 in NBA Cup group play.
